title: Just the size I needed
text: Just the size I needed. This is the correct size for me at least although they are small it's perfect for decoration I do like the big ones as well but these just look a lot prettier once you place them both side by side also they make perfect vase fillers as well and look so neat and sparkly I definitely will be buying more of these.
